   "source": [
    "device = torch.device(\"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# load config from yaml\n",
    "with open(\"config/compress/vq.yaml\", \"r\") as f:\n",
    "    vq_config = yaml.safe_load(f)\n",
    "\n",
    "weight_path = \"./models/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B/original_weights/layer_0/self_attn.q_proj.pt\"\n",
    "hessian_diag = weight_path.replace(\"original_weights\", \"hessianDiags/seed_0/pajama/128\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "weight = torch.load(weight_path, map_location=device)[\"weight\"].to(torch.float32).clone().detach()\n",
    "hessian_diag = torch.load(hessian_diag, map_location=device)[\"hessianDiag\"].to(torch.float32)\n",
    "\n",
    "hessian_diag = hessian_diag/torch.median(hessian_diag)\n",
    "\n",
    "normalizer, normalized_weight = Normalizer.normalize_init(weight, norm_order=[0,1], zero = [False, False])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "compression_module = LinearVQ(weight=weight)\n",
    "compression_module.hessianDiag = hessian_diag\n",
    "compression_module.compress(**vq_config['kwargs'])\n",
    "compression_measure = (\n",
    "                    compression_module.get_n_bits(),\n",
    "                    compression_module.get_n_original_parameters(),\n",
    "                )\n",
    "print('weight shape', weight.shape)\n",
    "print('bits and num params', compression_measure)\n",
    "print('assignments shape', compression_module.assignments.shape)\n",
    "\n",
    "reconstruction_error = compression_module.get_reconstruction_error(hessian_diag)\n",
    "print('reconstruction_error', reconstruction_error)\n",
    "\n",
    "compression_severity = 1.5\n",
    "compression_str = f'{vq_config['kwargs']['n_bits']}_bits_to_{vq_config['kwargs']['n_bits']-compression_severity}_bits'\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n"
   ]
  },

    "def get_entropy(matrix):\n",
    "    unique_vals, counts = np.unique(matrix, return_counts=True)\n",
    "    probabilities = counts / np.prod(matrix.shape)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Calculate entropy: H = -Σ p(x) * log2(p(x))\n",
    "    entropy = -np.sum(probabilities * np.log2(probabilities + 1e-12))  # Add epsilon for numerical stability\n",
    "    return entropy"
   ]
  },

    "def invert_permutation(permutation):\n",
    "    inv = np.empty_like(permutation)\n",
    "    inv[permutation] = np.arange(len(inv), dtype=inv.dtype)\n",
    "    return inv"
   ]

    "def create_error_matrix(codebook, huffman_codes, length_scaling=1):\n",
    "    codebook_copy = codebook.flatten()\n",
    "    distance = torch.abs(codebook_copy.unsqueeze(0) - codebook_copy.unsqueeze(1))\n",
    "    distance = distance.clone().detach().cpu().numpy()\n",
    "    inv_distance = 1/(distance + 1e-8) # need to figure out numerical stabilty later\n",
    "    for i in range(distance.shape[0]):\n",
    "        inv_distance[i,i] = 0\n",
    "    print(inv_distance)\n",
    "    inv_distance = inv_distance\n",
    "\n",
    "    lengths = torch.zeros(len(huffman_codes), dtype=int)\n",
    "    for key, value in huffman_codes.items():\n",
    "        lengths[key] = len(value)\n",
    "    length_diff = lengths.unsqueeze(0) - lengths.unsqueeze(1)\n",
    "    print(length_diff)\n",
    "\n",
    "    clamped_length_diff = torch.clamp(length_diff, min=0)\n",
    "    print(clamped_length_diff)\n",
    "    clamped_length_diff = clamped_length_diff.cpu().numpy()\n",
    "\n",
    "    weight_error_matrix = inv_distance * length_scaling*clamped_length_diff\n",
    "\n",
    "    return weight_error_matrix, inv_distance, clamped_length_diff\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "    \n"
   ]
  },

    "def sorted_matrix_indices(matrix):\n",
    "    matrix = np.array(matrix)\n",
    "    flat_matrix = matrix.flatten()\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Get flat indices of values > 0\n",
    "    positive_mask = flat_matrix > 0\n",
    "    positive_indices = np.argsort(flat_matrix[positive_mask])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Get the original flat indices where values > 0\n",
    "    original_positive_flat_indices = np.flatnonzero(positive_mask)\n",
    "    sorted_flat_indices = original_positive_flat_indices[positive_indices]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Convert back to 2D indices\n",
    "    sorted_coords = np.unravel_index(sorted_flat_indices, matrix.shape)\n",
    "    return np.column_stack(sorted_coords)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "#TODO: currently only considering distance between centriods, could consider distance from actual value for more accuracy\n",
    "#       would increase computation by a lot tho.\n",
    "def greedy_reduction(weight_matrix, assignment_matrix, bit_count_matrix, index, hessian_diag, huffman_codes, bin_size, bin_bit_limit):\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # get length map for huffman codes\n",
    "    lengths = torch.zeros(len(huffman_codes), dtype=int)\n",
    "    for key, value in huffman_codes.items():\n",
    "        lengths[key] = len(value)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # assignments, bit count, weights, and hessian diag for the bin in question\n",
    "    bin_assignment = assignment_matrix[index[0], index[1] * bin_size:(index[1]+1) * bin_size]\n",
    "    bin_bit_count = bit_count_matrix[index[0], index[1] * bin_size:(index[1]+1) * bin_size]\n",
    "    bin_weights = weight_matrix[index[0], index[1] * bin_size:(index[1]+1) * bin_size]\n",
    "    bin_hessian_diag = hessian_diag[index[1] * bin_size: (index[1]+1) * bin_size]\n",
    "    inv_bin_hessian_diag = 1/(bin_hessian_diag + 1e-8)\n",
    "\n",
    "    bin_total_bits = torch.sum(bin_bit_count)\n",
    "\n",
    "    # keep rounding untill under bit limit\n",
    "    while bin_total_bits > bin_bit_limit:\n",
    "        # distance matrix: for each element in bin, what is the distance to each centriod\n",
    "\n",
    "        # print(bin_weights.unsqueeze(1).shape)\n",
    "        # print(codebook.unsqueeze(0).shape)\n",
    "        distance_matrix = torch.abs(bin_weights.unsqueeze(1) - codebook.squeeze().unsqueeze(0))\n",
    "        # print(distance_matrix.shape)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # want closer centriods to be weighed higher in the rounding metric\n",
    "        inv_distance_matrix = 1/(distance_matrix + 1e-8)\n",
    "        inv_distance_matrix = inv_distance_matrix.squeeze()\n",
    "\n",
    "        # for each element in bin, get the number of bits you are saving if you round to each centriod \n",
    "        # clamped to not ever look at longer centriods\n",
    "        length_diff = torch.clamp(bin_bit_count.unsqueeze(1) - lengths.unsqueeze(0), min=0)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # print('inv distance shape', inv_distance_matrix.shape)\n",
    "        # print('length diff shape', length_diff.shape)\n",
    "        # print('hesssiang diag shape', hessian_diag.shape)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # The metric for which element to round is their \"closeness\" to each centroid,\n",
    "        # multiplied by the number of bits you save, multiplied by the inv hessian diag for\n",
    "        # for that element, similar to Wanda (but inverted)\n",
    "        # This essential creates an \"error matrix\" for rounding, multiplied by how many bits you save\n",
    "        weight_error_matrix = inv_distance_matrix * length_diff * inv_bin_hessian_diag.unsqueeze(1)\n",
    "        # print('weight_error_matrix', weight_error_matrix.shape)\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # Get 2d argmax as solution to greedy step\n",
    "        # Should represent the element that needs to be rounded\n",
    "        # and the centroid you need to round it to\n",
    "        greedy_step = torch.argmax(weight_error_matrix)\n",
    "        # print(greedy_step)\n",
    "        # greedy_element, greedy_new_assignment = greedy_step[0], greedy_step[1]\n",
    "        greedy_element = greedy_step//len(huffman_codes)\n",
    "        greedy_new_assignment = greedy_step % len(huffman_codes)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Update the element in question\n",
    "        bin_assignment[greedy_element] = greedy_new_assignment\n",
    "        bin_bit_count[greedy_element] = lengths[greedy_new_assignment]\n",
    "        bin_total_bits -= length_diff[greedy_element, greedy_new_assignment]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # Update the bin\n",
    "    assignment_matrix[index[0], index[1] * bin_size:(index[1]+1) * bin_size] = bin_assignment\n",
    "    bit_count_matrix[index[0], index[1] * bin_size:(index[1]+1) * bin_size] = bin_bit_count\n",
    "    weight_matrix[index[0], index[1] * bin_size:(index[1]+1) * bin_size] = bin_weights\n",
    "    \n",
    "    \n",
    "\n",
    "    \n",
    "    \n",
    "    "
   ]
